reason: User confirmed one fixed 60-day date interval. Re-fitting the same complete data has identical parameters.
historical_predictors: Updated through each forecast origin, but no May labels enter parameter fitting.
unseen_target_month: May-specific dummy never varies in training and is omitted. May has no estimated month-specific effect. Month levels encountered are logged; no future parameters are estimated.
static_features: Population, density and static commuting attributes absorbed by ZIP FE. Exact duplicate sums/velocity not separately represented.
sparse_history: Reset at fixed interval start. No pre-March case history used.
evaluation: Exploratory historical replay. Existing cohort/feature definitions used later data. No untouched-test or real-time reporting-delay claim.
trajectory: Three raw daily-count predictions from one origin; no 3-day smoothing of prediction targets.

shape_metrics.primary_direction_rule: Signs of day3-minus-day1, exact zero classified flat. Threshold 0.5 and 1 cases/day are prespecified sensitivity summaries, not tuned choices.
